title: Think Twice, Act Once: Token-Aware Compression and Action Reuse for Efficient Inference in Vision-Language-Action Models

tldr.en: Training-free token selection and action reuse skip redundant VLA decoding during stable steps.
tldr.zh: 免训练地筛选视觉 token，并在稳定步骤复用动作，跳过冗余解码。

evaluation_scope.en: LIBERO evaluation of the 2025 token-compression/action-reuse method. Timing hardware: pending extraction.
evaluation_scope.zh: 2025 年 token 压缩与动作复用方法，使用 LIBERO 评测。计时硬件待补。
